eligibility.quote:
`GLOBAL_POSITION_INT` MAVlink [message](https://mavlink.io/en/messages/common.html#GLOBAL_POSITION_INT) expresses velocity in NED frame therefore a NED->ENU conversion is needed to comply with ROS 2 standard.

FIX: #2054: instead of converting into `ENU`, the code was converting into `END` frame.

loudness.quote: When filling mavros topic `global_position/local` and converting the linear velocity frame from `NED` to `ENU` the `z` coordinate is not consistent with the transformation, in fact, it remains positive toward down.

resolution.quote: FIX: #2054: instead of converting into `ENU`, the code was converting into `END` frame.

notes: Verified against mavros issue #2054 and PR #2226. Global position linear velocity conversion improperly left the z component positive downwards (END rather than ENU).
